move: card tilts up from flat, sheen sweeps, feature rows stack, fold back
how: A dark 1080 square with a perspective stage, a heading in a mask, a card (chip, brand, number, name, expiry, two circles, a diagonal sheen) and three feature rows with icon, text and value. The heading rises; the card comes from rotationX 70, y 180, scale 0.9, opacity 0 to rest (expo.out, 1s, at 2.5%); the sheen sweeps xPercent -60 to 60 (power2.inOut); card details fade up. From 20% the features drop in from y -40 scaleY 0.6 opacity 0 with a 0.14s stagger (expo.out), their text rises through masks, values slide in and icons pop with back.out(3). During the hold the card rocks rotationY -14 rotationX 6 and back (sine.inOut) while a proxy tween counts the cashback value to 248. At 80% the features fold back up from the last (power3.in), the card flips away rotationX -70 y -120 and the heading exits.
adapt: Change the card art and strings, the three features and values, the accent colours; keep the 1s expo.out tilt-in and the 0.14s feature stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the card and feature rows; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with card at 0.025D, features 0.2D, hold rock 0.3D, exit 0.8D. The counter onUpdate ports as-is; el needs perspective; scope selectors to el.
